title: Utanga Ubutumwa Bukomeye
intro: Roho y'intungane yoherejwe kuyobora abantu bazimiye mu byaha bitigeze bibaho. Iyi ntumwa yakomeje gushikama, itanga umuburo ukomeye ku birebana n'ubugizi bwa nabi bunyuranyije n'amategeko karemano. Nubwo abantu basabye cyane, umuryango winjiye mu mwijima mwinshi, ushyiraho inzira yo kubazwa Imana mu buryo budasanzwe. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu mugaragu w'Imana ushikamye?
clues: Nari mwene wabo w'undi muhanuzi ukomeye, kandi nimukiye hamwe na we, mva igihugu cyacu.
Natumwe ku bantu bafite ububi budasanzwe, icyaha nta kiremwa na kimwe cyakoze mbere yabo.
Umuryango wanjye wari waracitsemo ibice; umuntu wo mu muryango wanjye wa hafi yashyigikiye abatizera mu ibanga.
Abamarayika, bambaye nk'abasore beza, baje iwanjye nk'abashyitsi, bantera agahinda kenshi ku bw'umutekano wabo.
Natanze abakobwa banjye ku bwoko bwanjye kugira ngo mbashyingire, mgerageza cyane kubabuza gukora ibikorwa byabo biteye isoni.
Abantu banjye barimbuwe n'induru mbi n'imvura y'amabuye y'ibumba ryatetse, mu gihe njye n'umuryango wanjye, uretse umwe, twarokotse tuvuye mu ijoro.

options: Imijyi yarasenyutse kandi ijugunywamo amabuye y'ibumba ryatekeshejwe.

Ifi nini cyane yaranyoye nyuma yo guhagarika ubutumwa bwanjye.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verse: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were] (11:82)
